stage: initial read-only review, not final implementation acceptance
scope: Native-validated model-only display/query index; no second author parser or semantic source admission.
Temporary viewing-camera framing and original-source cursor navigation; no author camera/environment update, applyDraft, Save, World or backend authority.

confirmedContracts.locationAuthority: Strict detached source snapshot3 data captured; native parse rebuilds object UUID UTF-16 ranges; caller ranges are not trusted.
confirmedContracts.completion: Before selecting source range, host checks isCurrent plus active doc/load/draft/token/path/raw/baseline/version/navrequest. On UI success close({restoreFocus:false}), guarded host focus() checks source owner/request, not now-closed UI guard.
confirmedContracts.index: Private branded query accepts only model-derived frozen display index; filter is a display projection, not a source validation parser.

reviewFocus: Actual full bytes equality including BOM/CRLF/non-BMP Unicode; native locations slice exact whole object and decoded key order.
Missing/unknown UUID, newer query/selection/load, same-path reload, source drift, close/dispose, request overlap and late completion do not select or focus stale source.
Source cursor/scroll may intentionally change; content, saved baseline/version/disk cache/dirty state do not. No renderer or authoring controller receives editor mutation ports.
textContent for raw HTML/control/Unicode names; language update preserves query and stable UUID selection, empty result disables source/frame actions consistently.
Eight transformed corners enclosed in rotated nonuniform box sphere/clip checks; actual framebuffer aspect, narrow/wide fov, extreme size/position remain finite with valid temporary clip planes.

Reset restores author camera exact; new model/dispose releases temporary camera/frame/drag state. Invalid newer source may retain old image with explicit stale state, while old source navigation refuses.
limitations: Design/source seam review only; independent current implementation probes and final preservation are deferred until owners declare readiness. No compilation, installation, deletion or semantic runtime performed.
